mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 9.0% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when UNRATE < 9.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST > 550k units) and consumer spending (RSAFS > 360k million dollars) indicates strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when both HOUST > 550k and RSAFS > 360k, or interaction Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, sustained industrial production above 95.0 index points signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of late-cycle periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL annual change exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts above 550,000 units signal strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST > 550,000, or Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 9.5%) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 131k) indicates labor market tightening that enhances consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90.0 index points signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.
